notes:
Recorded under the owner's v0.17 assurance-closure mandate of 2026-09-07, priority 4, whose instruction is the shape of this registration: measure BOTH feature realizations, because a green result under one is not evidence about the other, and register a unit only after both are explicitly represented. Recorded by the implementing agent as routine owner-review maintenance, not as a transcription of a ruling naming this fingerprint.

THIS CLOSES THE GAP THM-0108'S SCOPE NAMES BY NAME: 'How a failed remote-signer call is classified, and whether it arms the handshake-path throttle, is remote_signer_call's authority. It has no unit, it is gated on any(aws_kms_keysource, gcp_kms_keysource) — the shape that makes a single-feature lane silent about the other — and it is recorded as a named gap rather than absorbed here.'

BOTH REALIZATIONS MEASURED, SEPARATELY AND FOR REAL: 14 controls under aws_kms_keysource alone, 15 under gcp_kms_keysource alone. The two are different TYPES — RemoteSignerFailure::after and ::describe are gcp-only, because Cloud KMS has a refused-bearer-token retry and AWS SigV4 re-signs per call and has no round to chain a cause from. TWO UNITS and not one test_features list, on the proxy.continuation_materialization / _shared precedent: whichever lane runs, the other's control does not exist, so a single unit would name a battery member absent half the time. The gcp unit measures ONE control — what its realization adds and the other cannot — because everything the two arms share is measured by the aws unit with controls that are not cfg-gated and therefore run in both lanes; restating them would put one fact under two owners.

AN EVIDENCE GAP INSIDE THE OWNERSHIP GAP. The module tested only its PARTS — is_load_shedding_status and json_string_field — and the RULE that composes them, quota_verdict, had no control at all. Five were added, over both providers' real data shapes: a shed-load status is exhaustion whatever the body says (a front-door 429 states no service error shape at all, so reading the body first would leave the window unarmed); a stated name arms the window at each provider's own path, with AWS's namespace suffix compared rather than the whole string; a body that states no name arms nothing; one provider's vocabulary does not arm the other's window; and a call that got no answer arms nothing.

THE DIRECTION THAT MATTERS MOST is the negative one. A permanent misconfiguration classified as exhaustion becomes a permanent LOCAL refusal that hides the misconfiguration it came from — so a body that states nothing must not read as a positive, however it fails to state it.

WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: nothing about the throttle window itself once armed, which is handshake_quota's; not that either provider's exhausted set is complete, since a name a provider adds later reads as 'not quota', the same safe direction an unparseable body takes; and nothing about either adapter's custody, which is THM-0108's and the adapters' own.
